text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the dance studio to observe 
Hokko Tarumae's lesson.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, feels like something's missing... 
What could it be, though...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"If I get more opportunities in the 
spotlight, I can put Tomakomai on the map. 
That's why I want to do my best in the 
concerts, but..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... If only I knew more about live 
performances—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah―― Oh, right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae dashed off suddenly, only to 
return with Agnes Digital in tow for some 
reason.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"A-Ah... Um, excuse me... W-What business 
might you have with someone like me...?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Digital-chan! As a pro idol fan, I have a 
favor to ask of you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyah!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I'm having some trouble with my dance 
expression right now... Digital-chan, 
could you give me your thoughts?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Please! Digital-chan has such a discerning 
eye! No one is better suited for this than 
you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hngh...!! Wh-Wh-What dazzling ambition!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Even though you're already a hyper-pretty 
local idol who puts on such exceedingly 
adorable, pure, and charming 
performances!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Um, I know it's a mountain of presumption 
for someone like me to give an opinion!! 
But, but still—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If it's for my beloved oshi when she's in 
need...!! Unworthy as I may be, I shall do 
my absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!! Now then, what should I have 
you look at first...?
choice_data_list: Let's get some feedback on the dancing.

Let's get some feedback on the 
performance.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: You're right! Then let's right away—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyeeeeh~~!! So cuuuute~~!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: It's kind of like this, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *wheeze*... Sh-She was so cute I 
almost ascended to heaven... If she 
started hopping around on top of that, it 
would've been fatal...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I see...! If we make it a jump, the 
movement gets bigger and can express an 
even happier feeling...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Um, like this, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hnghhh...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: My heart... feels all mushy and melting...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Digital-chan, are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Hokko Tarumae received various 
pieces of advice, making her dance even 
more captivating.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You're right! In order to differentiate 
myself from the other girls, I need to 
show some originality.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Digital-chan, could you tell me your 
favorite performance? I want to know what 
the fans are looking for!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The one I like!?!?!?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
There's all kinds of fan service during 
concerts, but the ultimate best is a blown 
kiss—though asking for that much feels too 
shameless, and I'd just die of bliss 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I should exercise restraint and say I 
faint just from a wave. But will that 
really support my fave? How should I 
answer—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... Blowing a kiss and 
waving... ...It's a little embarrassing, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: This, too... is for Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Hup!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Digital-chan, are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the advice she managed to get 
afterward, Hokko Tarumae's performance 
became even more captivating.
